## 09 – Error Handler (shared)
Set as "Error workflow" of 00–08. Builds a short, redacted summary (no stack, no data) and posts it to `ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` (Slack or Discord incoming webhook) when configured.
Also called by 01 and 06 for **soft failures** (N-2): failed completion, unconfirmed start, AI unavailable, result not stored.

nodes.name: When called with a soft failure
nodes.notes: N-2: called by 01 and 06 ("Notify error handler (09)") with the same shape as the Error Trigger output.

nodes.name: Summarize error
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, keys, JWTs and webhook URLs.

nodes.name: Send notification
nodes.notes: POST ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL. The URL is a secret: it is read from the environment here and never written to an item.

nodes.name: Logged only
nodes.notes: The summary stays in the n8n execution log.
